Tests in your plan
Lactate dehydrogenase (LDH)
WHEN
Before treatment and before each 28-day cycle.
A blood result followed alongside the clinical assessment in this regimen.
A change is interpreted with other findings; it does not establish tumour growth by itself.
Creatine kinase (CK / CPK) and creatinine
WHEN
Before treatment and monthly during treatment, or sooner for symptoms.
Checks for muscle injury and its effect on the kidneys.
Report new muscle pain, weakness or dark urine promptly.

PICC care and urgent line symptoms
A PICC usually needs regular dressing and flushing appointments even between treatments. Fever, redness, swelling, pain, leakage or
damage requires prompt advice. Your hospital supplies the exact care instructions.
Sources: NCCP 00936 v1 · official regimen · eviQ · implanted port patient information. Source reconciled; independent clinical, pharmacy and patient/PPI review pending.
